reason: Explains the impact of climate change on food prices and offers solutions.

tasks.task: Describe the impact of climate change on crop yields.

subtasks.text: Observe how droughts can significantly reduce wheat crop yields, leading to higher global prices.
Note that floods in key coffee-producing regions also affect coffee bean production and hence the price of coffee.

tasks.task: Explain how extreme weather events affect livestock farming.

subtasks.text: Observe heat waves stress animals, reducing their productivity and increasing mortality rates.
Highlight how this can lead to higher wheat prices despite not being directly intended.

tasks.task: Present solutions to mitigate the impact of climate change on agriculture.

subtasks.text: Note the importance of investing in climate-resilient agriculture to develop drought-resistant crops.
Mention the need to improve irrigation systems to address the issue of crop yield reduction.
Describe the benefits of supporting sustainable farming practices for food security and stability.
Highlight the role of diversifying food sources and supply chains to reduce vulnerability to climate-related disruptions.
